app.title: VHS Professional Restorer
app.subtitle: Support for Multiple Devices (DeckLink / USB / Hardware TBC)

settings.audio_sync_help: Positive values delay audio. Negative values advance it.
settings.crf_help: Lower = Better Quality / Larger File. Default: 18-20.
settings.chroma_help: Aligns bleeding colors shifted to the right (common in old tapes).
settings.denoise_help: Applies HQDN3D to clean visual noise without destroying texture.
settings.comb_help: Useful for composite video captures without Line TBC.
settings.overscan_help: Paints an 8px black border to hide VHS head switching noise.
settings.audio_treat_help: Normalizes to -23 LUFS (TV/YouTube Standard) and cuts low noise.
